items.title: Somalia braces for El Niño floods as millions face risk of hunger
items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year. Nuh Adan, a farmer and community leader in Bayahaaw, said flooding caused by breached riverbanks could devastate local agriculture for months. "If the river breaks and the floods hit us, the effects will last until the next rainy season in March," Adan said. items.description: A 16-point joint statement circulated by Al-Shabaab-affiliated media  said the sides had resolved their disputes and agreed to maintain peace in areas controlled or influenced by the clan. Macawiisley forces from Hiiraan have played a key role in supporting Somali government troops against Al-Shabaab. items.titleIt: Death toll rises to 139 after migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti

items.title: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 29 OTT - The shareholders of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Thursday rejected a proposal for the bank to merge with Mediobanca. The proposal needed the support of two-thirds of the bank's capital to be approved, but 63.65% voted against, with only 32.91% in favour and 3.42% abstaining. The merger was part of CEO Luigi Lovaglio's plan to fend off a 33-billion-euro takeover ‌bid by Intesa Sanpaolo for MPS. Intesa Sanpaolo had asked MPS's shareholders to reject the merger, in view of its takeover. MPS took over Mediobanca, Italy's premier merchant bank, earlier this year. Lovag
items.titleIt: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
